mapper.select: SELECT count( 1 ) bidTimes, COUNT( t.is_win = 'Y' ) winTimes, t.VENDOR_ID vendorId, t.VENDOR_NAME vendorName FROM ( SELECT p.PROJECT_ID, d.is_win, v.VENDOR_ID, v.VENDOR_NAME FROM scc_sou_project p JOIN scc_sou_vendor v ON v.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID AND v.VENDOR_ID IN #{item} LEFT JOIN scc_npm_sou_bid_notice n ON n.project_id = p.PROJECT_ID AND n.type = 'APPLY' AND n.`status` = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN scc_npm_sou_bid_notice_detail d ON d.bid_notice_id = n.bid_notice_id AND d.is_win = 'Y' AND d.vendor_id = v.VENDOR_ID WHERE p.SOU_TYPE = 'bid' AND p.EXT_CATEGORY_ID = #{extCategoryId} GROUP BY p.PROJECT_ID, v.VENDOR_ID ) t GROUP BY t.VENDOR_ID
